provenance.method: Global BLOSUM62 sequence alignment (gap open -10, extend -0.5); proper-rotation Kabsch fit; up to 8 monotone trimming iterations; if rejected, retry with up to 30 residual-refinement iterations with re-entry (median + 3 scaled MAD, bounded 2-5 A). Retry retained-fraction acceptance is evaluated after convergence. If both existing fits fail, a final converged core fit retains the same core quality gates but treats all-matched RMSD above 12 A as a domain-displacement warning, not rejection. The 8CH6–8I0P pair was separately recomputed with a partial-core fallback requiring at least 200 residues and 40% retained, with an explicit warning. All previously rejected pairs citing the 60% core cutoff were reassessed against matching coordinate probes with the partial-core fallback (at least 200 residues and 40% retained); other existing results were preserved.

coordinate_probes.frame: original deposited model 1, before comparison transform
coordinate_probes.policy: Require all probes of the selected anchor to match before display. Sampling detects frame changes and many revisions but does not establish complete model identity.

provenance.matrix_convention: Column-major 4x4, mobile deposited coordinates to reference deposited coordinates; R*x+t.
provenance.interpretation: An anchor fit is a navigational aid, not validation that the entire spliceosome is equivalent. Linked residue mapping is limited to this anchor; missing residues are never interpolated.
